svg.text: Diagram D: File Upload and Async Processing Pipeline
Upload Files (Primary + Optional OBJ Assets), No Duplicate
Validate cookie + CSRF + check survey access
Validate primary file + confirm assets are OBJ-only
Compute SHA-256 checksum of primary file
Check checksum for existing SurveyFile on survey
Promote staged primary file to canonical storage
Compute SHA-256 checksum of primary file
Check checksum for existing SurveyFile on survey
Discard staged upload; no new records created
UPDATE file status=processing; UPDATE job status=running
Fetch primary (+ asset) file(s) from canonical storage
Generate preview / convert (COG+tiles or GLB), store output
Client Polls Processing Status (PostgreSQL is source of truth)
Manual Retry (SE or Admin, after permanent failure)
Validate cookie + CSRF + check role (SE or Admin)
- More than one primary 'file' part, or zero: 400
- Unsupported file type / bad MIME: 400 INVALID_FILE_TYPE
- Manual retry while job is not FAILED_PERMANENT: 409
- Manual retry beyond configured max: 429 RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
- Unsafe request without valid CSRF token: 403 CSRF_FAILURE
- Files Module streams to a private staging area first,
then promotes to canonical private storage only after
- Duplicate checksum short-circuits before any SurveyFile,
- One SurveyFile maps to exactly one ProcessingJob; retries
(automatic or manual) always update that same job
- Redis is used only as the Celery broker; ProcessingJob in
PostgreSQL is the sole source of truth for status/progress
- No external message-broker event is published on
completion; nothing outside this service is notified
- Dashed orange box: Drone Mapping Service boundary
- Colored modules inside the box are internal
- Auth is via HttpOnly cookie, not an Authorization header
